projects.name: Peace and Gov1.1.3 ESCWA: Advisory and technical support for deploying the ESCWA Monitoring Application for Reporting on the SDGs (MARS) in Lebanon
projects.description: In 2025, ESCWA provided advisory and technical support to initiate the deployment of the Monitoring Application for Reporting on the SDGs (MARS) in Lebanon. Preparatory meetings were held to lay the groundwork for establishing the national network of data providers. A key coordination meeting took place on 20 May 2025 to present the requirements and structure for the national MARS setup, with participation from relevant stakeholders. The process of setting up the system is underway, with national engagement progressing through ESCWA’s continued support.

projects.name: People1.2.1 ESCWA: Support in finalizing and launching the national action plan to implement Lebanon's older persons' strategy 2020-2030
projects.description: Following its technical support in developing Lebanon’s National Strategy for Older Persons (2020–2030), ESCWA provided advisory services to finalize and launch the accompanying national action plan. After extensive national consultations, the plan was finalized in late 2024 based on inputs from the Ministry of Social Affairs. At the Minister’s request, ESCWA supported the plan’s refinement and official launch, which took place on 30 January 2025. The launch marked a significant step toward mobilizing resources and operationalizing the strategy, aimed at advancing the rights and well-being of older persons in Lebanon.
